title: Overseas Trade Statistics API (uktradeinfo)
notes: Monthly UK imports by CN8 commodity and recorded partner. Partner = country of dispatch, which may differ from where goods were grown. Imports valued CIF (statistical value; Intrastat EU trade uses invoice value). Net mass in kg; about a third of Intrastat goods need no weight declaration and are estimated. Provisional for up to 18 months after publication. Series breaks: EU exit (Jan 2021) and customs-based GB–EU import collection (Jan 2022).

title: UK import trade in goods by country of origin and country of dispatch, 2024
notes: Context only (Evidence page caveat on the Netherlands dispatch effect). Not used for figures: it covers only trade where both origin and dispatch were declared.

title: United Kingdom Food Security Report 2024, theme 3 (food supply chain resilience): chart data
publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
notes: Theme 3 dataset FSR-theme3-241211.ods: 3_2_2a food, feed and drink imports by port of entry (2022, 2023), 3_2_2b Short Straits share by food group, 3_2_1a average delay on England's Strategic Road Network. Values as published; next report due December 2027.

title: Horticulture statistics 2025
publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
notes: Accompanying dataset hort-dataset-25-20260625.ods (published 25 June 2026): tomatoes (Table 23) and strawberries (Table 12) — home production marketed, imports, exports, total supply and home production as a share of supply, calendar years. Annual national context only; Defra's trade figures use its own product definitions (fresh produce where distinguishable), not the Food Origins baskets.

title: Agriculture in the United Kingdom 2025, chapter 7: crops
publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
notes: Dataset AUK-chapter7-20260709.ods (published 9 July 2026, updated 3 September 2026): wheat (Table 7.2c) and potatoes (Table 7.10c) supply and use, with production as a percentage of total new supply; 2025 provisional. Annual national context only.

title: Grocery Retail Points (v46, June 2026)
licence: GEOLYTIX open data, no named licence ("completely free and open to use data")
notes: Store locations, retailer, fascia and size band as delivered (provided by John, 24 Oct 2026). Class from size_band (convenience under 280 m², supermarket 280 m² and over); forecourt, motorway, travel and hospital formats flagged; wholesale and mainly non-food stores left out (decision D5). Retail presence only: no turnover, prices or opening hours.

title: Priority Places for Food Index v2.1
publisher: Consumer Data Research Centre / Leeds Healthy & Sustainable Places Data Service
notes: Ranks and deciles within each nation (England 33,755 LSOAs, Wales 1,917, Scotland 6,976 Data Zones (2011), Northern Ireland 890 SOAs 2011) for the combined index and seven domains; three domains have no Northern Ireland data. Decile 1 = highest priority: the publisher's documentation does not state the direction; it was checked against the deprivation indices. Never compared across nations. File provided by John (HASP download, 25 Oct 2026).

title: Local Authority Districts (May 2025) Boundaries UK (BGC for display, BFE for store assignment)
notes: Source: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v.3.0. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2025. 361 councils; display edition generalised to 20 m, clipped to the coastline and further simplified for the web.

title: LSOA 2021 boundaries, population-weighted centroids and lookup (England and Wales)
notes: Lower layer Super Output Areas (December 2021) BGC V5, population-weighted centroids V4 and the LSOA 2021 → ward 2025 → council 2025 lookup, for the Manchester deep profile; the lookup for every LSOA assigns the Priority Places index to councils in England and Wales (Stage 6). Source: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v.3.0. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2025.

title: Data Zones 2021 and population-weighted centroids
publisher: Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency
notes: 3,780 Data Zones (Irish Grid TM65, EPSG:29902) and their Census 2021 population-weighted centroids, for the Belfast deep profile. Contains Ordnance Survey of Northern Ireland information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

title: Population estimates for the UK, England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland: mid-2025
publisher: Office for National Statistics (with NRS and NISRA)
notes: Usual residents at 30 June 2025 for all four nations (accredited official statistics), on council boundaries of April 2024; land area excluding inland water (Standard Area Measurements, January 2025; NISRA for Northern Ireland). Barnsley and Sheffield figures predate their 2025 boundary change.

title: Deprivation indices: English Indices of Deprivation 2025; Northern Ireland Multiple Deprivation Measure 2017
publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government; NISRA
notes: IoD 2025 File 7 (England, LSOA 2021, ranks and deciles within England); NIMDM 2017 (Northern Ireland, SOA 2011, ranks within Northern Ireland; deciles derived, 89 SOAs each). Each index ranks areas within its own nation only and they are never compared.

title: Car or van availability (Census 2021)
notes: England and Wales: TS045 (households by number of cars or vans), councils and LSOAs. Northern Ireland: NISRA flexible table builder HH_CAR_VAN_TC5 by Data Zone and council (files from John). Census day 21 March 2021. Scotland (Census 2022) not included.

title: Rural–urban classifications
notes: England and Wales: ONS 2021 Rural Urban Classification of councils (LAD 2024) and LSOAs (2021). Northern Ireland: NISRA 2015 default urban/rural class per SOA (from the NIMDM 2017 file; no council-level class, no Census 2021-based edition). Scotland not included. Classifications differ by nation and are never compared.

title: Port freight annual statistics 2025 (PORT0499, PORT0304, major and minor port list)
notes: Accredited official statistics. PORT0499: major-port tonnage by year (2000-2025), direction, cargo group and category, and region and country of the port of load or unload; reconciled with PORT0304 for 2025. The port list gives UN/LOCODEs, nations and a rough map location for 27 of 53 statistical ports. Tonnage of all cargo: only 'agricultural products (eg grain, soya, tapioca)' is food- or feed-related; unitised traffic (containers, roll-on/roll-off) is not recorded by commodity.

title: Natural Earth Admin 0 countries (1:110m outlines, 1:50m label points)
notes: v5.1.2 GeoJSON from the Natural Earth repository (tag v5.1.2), pinned by SHA-256. ISO_A2_EH is the join key to HMRC CountryCodeAlpha (gate G4). Label points are Natural Earth's own LABEL_X/LABEL_Y, used as the symbolic start of import connections. Reference geometry only; boundaries are not an endorsement.

title: ArcGIS Basemap styles service
licence: Esri terms of use; attribution rendered by the SDK
notes: Dark grey style (arcgis/dark-gray), used when an ArcGIS API key is configured (Actions secret ARCGIS_API_KEY). Loads on the live site (post-deploy smoke test, 23 Oct 2026); not reachable from the build sandbox.

title: Food hygiene rating open data (Northern Ireland councils)
notes: Register of food businesses for the 11 Northern Ireland councils; used only to show grocers that GEOLYTIX does not map (supplementary layer, never counted in rates). A registration is not proof of a grocery offer or opening hours.

title: Level of water stress (SDG 6.4.2), FAO AQUASTAT, through the World Bank API
publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (AQUASTAT); World Bank (World Development Indicators)
notes: Freshwater withdrawal as a percentage of available freshwater resources, by country; latest year 2022 (2021 for two countries). FAO's SDG 6.4.2 classes: no stress below 25 %, low, medium, high, critical above 100 %. A national figure for the whole country; it does not describe the growing region, season or irrigation of any import.

title: Structure of the agricultural industry in England and the UK at June: England regions and UK key results by country
publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
notes: June 2025 survey results: wheat area, cattle, sheep, pigs and poultry for the 8 Defra regions of England (commercial holdings; London counted with the South East) and for Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland (each country's own survey or census). England's regional cattle (commercial holdings) total less than the all-holdings England figure.

title: 2011 Data Zone Lookup (Scotland)
notes: Assigns Scotland's 6,976 2011 Data Zones (the geography of the Priority Places index in Scotland) to the 32 current councils. Windows-1252 text.

title: International Territorial Level 1 (January 2025) Boundaries UK BGC
notes: 12 ITL1 regions (EPSG:27700), used to draw Defra's agricultural statistics regions (London merged with the South East) and the three devolved countries. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2025.

title: OS Open Roads (Great Britain)
notes: GeoPackage (about 1 GB) processed on GitHub Actions: motorways and trunk roads ('strategic': the national highway authorities' networks) and other primary-route A roads ('primary'), merged by road number and simplified at 60 m. Great Britain only. Road corridors, not freight flows. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right.

title: EMODnet Human Activities, Main ports: port locations
publisher: EMODnet Human Activities (originators Eurofish International Organisation and Cogea Srl)
notes: Port points keyed by UN/LOCODE (as in DfT's port list), georeferenced from Eurostat GISCO 'Ports 2013' where possible, otherwise UN/LOCODE or other sources (recorded per port). Used only for DfT statistical ports without a DfT map location (24 of 51).
